latestVersion.changelog:
帮中小企业老板看清”钱从哪来、花到哪去、还剩多少”。支持账单导入、收支记录、应收应付追踪和现金流预测。
Help SME owners see clearly where money comes from, where it goes, and how much is left. Supports bill import, income/expense tracking, AR/AP monitoring, and cashflow forecasting.
Initial release — bill import, income/expense ledger, AR/AP tracking, cashflow forecast.
